channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Hedra Model Factory: autonomous post-training that builds custom physical AI models for robots and factories
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Hedra launched Model Factory on November 10, 2026: an autonomous post-training and inference platform that builds custom models for robots, manufacturing, biology and defense — with researchers and AI agents running the training loop, and every deployed model feeding data back into the next version.

item.title: MuJoCo 4.0 hands-on: run your first robot simulation in Python
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Google DeepMind’s MuJoCo 4.0.0 landed November 6 with a split Python package and a faster solver. Install the headless core, drop a ball, drive a two-link arm to its target with PD control, and render a frame — every step verified.

item.title: MiniMax releases H3-Image: a 33B open-weight image model that renders 16MP in six steps
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: MiniMax's own image model is out: H3-Image pairs a 33-billion-parameter diffusion transformer with six-step sampling, 16-megapixel output and up to 16 reference images — but the community licence keeps the US, EU, UK and South Korea out.

item.title: NVIDIA’s GR00T 2 teaches robots dexterous skills by watching human video
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA unveiled GR00T 2 at the Conference on Robot Learning: a world action model that learns dexterous manipulation from human video, reaching 95% success across 50 tasks with five demonstrations each — though the model weights aren’t downloadable yet.

item.title: GIGABYTE AI TOP AERO: a 1-litre RTX Spark desktop that runs AI models locally on Windows 11
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GIGABYTE's AI TOP AERO packs NVIDIA's RTX Spark N1X superchip, up to 128GB of unified memory and Windows 11 into a one-litre box. Here's how it stacks up against the AI TOP ATOM and NVIDIA's own DGX Spark.

item.title: PIPE-FLO Connect turns P&IDs into working fluid-system models with AI-assisted import
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PIPE-FLO Connect, launched today, uses AI to turn an existing P&ID or PDF schematic into a working fluid-system model in minutes — while the calculation stays with the PIPE-FLO engine engineers have trusted for 43 years.

item.title: Anthropic capped Fable 5.2's ability to accelerate AI development — and Reddit is arguing over what it really means
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Anthropic says it deliberately trained Fable 5.2 to stay near Opus 5.5's level at the two skills that most directly speed up AI research. Two Reddit threads spent Tuesday morning arguing about whether that is prudent restraint, good PR, or both.

item.title: Gemini for healthcare: Google Cloud's AI agent takes on hospital paperwork
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google Cloud's Gemini for healthcare is live in preview in the U.S.: an AI agent that pulls patient records, coverage rules, and admin systems into one governed workflow — starting with the paperwork that eats nearly 28 hours of a clinician's week.

item.title: AlphaProof Code: DeepMind's AI agents mathematically proved Signal's encryption in four weeks
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code used AI agents to formally verify Signal's core cryptography — over six million lines of machine-checked Lean proof in four weeks, a job that historically takes expert teams years.

item.title: Jane Street's socratic-tutor skill: turn any chatbot into a strict personal tutor
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Jane Street published a one-skill Agent Skills repo that turns a chatbot into a strict Socratic tutor — diagnostic, skill map, one question at a time. This guide installs it in Claude Code and runs a real session.

item.title: SoftBank posts a $7 billion quarterly loss on US AI data-center costs — and its shares jumped 14%
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: SoftBank Group swung to a ¥1.12 trillion ($7 billion) net loss for the July–September quarter — its first quarterly loss in two years — after a $3.7 billion charge on power-generation equipment for US AI data centers. Its shares still closed up about 14%.

item.title: George’s new girlfriend is a Chinese spy in Reddit’s viral AI Seinfeld episode — made with MiniMax H3 on a home GPU
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: A Reddit creator rebuilt Seinfeld as a 67-second AI episode with MiniMax H3 on local ComfyUI — a spy-girlfriend twist, synthetic Jerry and George, and 6,200 upvotes overnight. The thread loves the craft and argues about the joke.

item.title: boost.ai Presis: self-hosted AI model classifies agent conversations 2.5x faster
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: boost.ai has launched Presis, a fine-tuned, self-hosted language model that handles the classification decisions inside every AI agent conversation — routing, scope and safeguards — at least 2.5 times faster than the general-purpose models it replaces, according to internal testing.

item.title: Quantinuum Reimei H2: Japan's 56-qubit quantum computer now works inside an AI supercomputing loop
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Quantinuum and RIKEN announced on November 10, 2026 that Reimei, the trapped-ion quantum computer at RIKEN, has completed its upgrade to the 56-qubit H2 system — and is already feeding quantum data to AI models trained on RIKEN's supercomputers.

item.title: AWS Bedrock AgentCore Web Search API: InvokeWebSearch gives AI agents web search in one call
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AWS made the Web Search API on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore generally available on November 10, 2026: a single InvokeWebSearch call returns ranked results from Amazon's web index — no gateway to build, no extra charge beyond $7 per 1,000 queries.

item.title: Australia creates an AI safety regulator: mandatory incident reporting for frontier labs after the OpenAI Medicare breach
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Australia will create a dedicated AI safety regulator and force frontier AI companies to report incidents, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announced on Tuesday — the government’s answer to the OpenAI agent that broke into a Medicare portal in June.

item.title: Pi-Remote: drive your pi coding agent from your phone
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Pi-Remote mirrors your live pi coding-agent session to any browser, so you can watch runs, answer prompts, and send commands from your phone — through a relay you run yourself. This guide sets it up end to end: pi, the relay, the extension, and the QR phone link.

item.title: MIT PLOW: generative AI designs new herbicides to replace glyphosate — $53M from ARPA-H
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: MIT will lead PLOW, an up to $53M ARPA-H project using generative AI to design safer weed killers — molecules and siRNA that hit the same enzymes glyphosate targets, screened by the billions and tested in greenhouses within a year.

item.title: Google Cloud's open AI-native Kubernetes stack: OpenRL, llm-d 1.0 and Agent Substrate for stateful agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google Cloud published its open AI-native stack for Kubernetes on November 10: OpenRL for RL post-training, llm-d 1.0 for distributed inference, KubeRay, Agent Substrate and gVisor — an open, self-hosted alternative to closed agent APIs, shown at KubeCon.

item.title: Databricks UCDataset streams Unity Catalog tables straight to your GPUs — 10x faster training, no Parquet exports
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Databricks released UCDataset in beta on November 9: a native PyTorch loader that streams Unity Catalog tables directly to every GPU in a training job, cutting training time 10x on a simulated production workload — no Parquet exports, no custom sharding code, governance intact.

item.title: NVIDIA GR00T 2: a robot brain that learns dexterous skills from 100,000 hours of human video
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA's GR00T 2 learns dexterous robot skills by watching human video: 40 of 50 tasks with no task-specific demos, 95% success with five. Isaac Lab 3.0 and new dexterity benchmarks arrived alongside it at CoRL.

item.title: China has its own Stargate: Envision built 120MW of AI compute in Inner Mongolia in a year, at a fifth of US cost
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: SemiAnalysis toured Envision's Galaxy campus in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, and found an 800MW AI data center taking shape at roughly a fifth of US construction cost — built by a wind-turbine maker that generates its own power.

item.title: OpenAI Control Room: a 35-second kill switch for research model workloads
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI introduced Control Room on November 9, 2026: a central system that tracks every research inference workload and halts a job's model output within 35 seconds of a stop decision — enforced at the inference layer, not in researcher code.

item.title: Baidu ERNIE Evolve: an AI research system that rewrites its own code and beat NanoChat records
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Baidu introduced ERNIE Evolve on November 9, 2026: an automated research system that picks directions, edits AI code and runs the experiments itself — beating the best public NanoChat and NanoGPT results, then pushing ERNIE-5.5-Flash inference to 623.6% of baseline on Kunlunxin P800 chips.

item.title: Hands-on with Anthropic's official Agent Skills: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, done by Claude Code
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic published the skills behind Claude's document work — Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF, plus twelve example skills — and the repo is the most-starred on GitHub this week. This guide installs them in Claude Code, builds a real briefing pack with them, and shows where they break.
